market_definition: The Global Antioxidants Market covers chemical antioxidant additives used in rubber, elastomers, plastics, and polymer formulations to prevent oxidative degradation during processing and service life. The market includes aromatic amine, hindered phenolic, phosphite and phosphonite, thioester, and other antioxidants used across automotive, industrial, healthcare, construction, electrical, and consumer applications. Excludes food, supplement, pharmaceutical and cosmetic antioxidants, standalone antiozonants, UV absorbers and light stabilizers, finished rubber and plastic products, upstream intermediates, and masterbatches sold as finished compounds.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor.
